approval_scope: This exact frozen local STAR-to-selective-BAM launch under existing authorization and guards. No patient alignment launched by reviewer. No approval for thresholds changed after seeing results.
interpretation_conditions: Capture includes M/=/X base-overlap records, not D/N-only ordinary records; therefore downstream comparisons should use unambiguous A/C/G/T query-name counts, not claim equality of all skip/deletion or nonACGT pileup inventories.

For frozen exceptional names the QNAME rule retains all records emitted by STAR even outside SNPs, including named D/N-only, secondary/supplementary and unmapped records. Completeness must be checked from actual capture name/mate inventories, not assumed.
Keep all4015 baseline sites and original DNA categories as the comparison denominator; report new low/zero coverage separately instead of replacing the cohort with surviving sites.
A new RNA alignment is not an independent specimen. Method differences can arise from versions, references, parameter settings, index sparsity and pair handling; not attributable solely to D8.
Sparse-index support changes are already documented; no clinical sensitivity, identity probability, contamination fraction or new treatment target follows from this branch.

External host writes or abrupt swap allocations can outrun polling; hard3GiB floor cannot be guaranteed against unrelated concurrent activity. Current driver aborts with0.5GiB margin and preserves partial evidence.
